# SpliX (excerpt)

The 0x11 compressor from [SpliX](https://github.com/OpenPrinting/splix), a CUPS driver for
SPL printers by Aurélien Croc (AP²C) and contributors. Licensed under GPL-2.0, see `COPYING`.

These files are unmodified copies from tag `2.0.2`
(commit `9bde257882a1ebcf15a97ff4685d34053383e3f8`).
